name: Balakot Air Strike Doctrine (2019)
description: IAF aerial strike deep inside Pakistan's Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province — first air force crossing of international border since 1971. Response to Pulwama suicide bombing.

trigger_event.event: Pulwama attack — Adil Ahmad Dar rams CRPF convoy, 40 killed

operation_details.target: JeM seminary/training facility at Balakot, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
operation_details.location: 80km inside Pakistan, beyond PoK (international border crossed)
operation_details.package: Escort: Su-30MKI, AWACS, IL-78 tankers, Heron drones

pakistani_response.27_february: PAF retaliatory strikes across LoC; F-16 vs MiG-21 dogfight
pakistani_response.abhinandan: Wing Commander Abhinandan Varthaman shot down, captured, released 60 hours later

strategic_significance.escalation_threshold: Crossed international border by air; established new retaliation ceiling
strategic_significance.deterrence_evolution: From ground (Surgical Strikes 2016) to air (Balakot 2019) to integrated (Sindoor 2025)
strategic_significance.pakistani_learning: Demonstrated Indian willingness to escalate despite nuclear threshold concerns

film_relevance.part_3: Central set-piece; aerial warfare spectacle; Abhinandan capture-return drama
